Before Jason Birdsong started JT Services, he was a repo man. He says it plainly: he legally stole cars for a living. Then came the 2008 recession. one is none,

One is none, two is some.

Jason Birdsong of {jt} learned it adding plumbing to his septic company. Bring on one plumber and sometimes it doesn't work out, and now you're back to none while you're working hard to book those calls. So he made sure he had two plumbers, and kept them busy, before he'd entertain another trade. Agree?

captions.facebook:
You work hard to book the calls, and then you don't have a plumber. That's what Jason Birdsong of JT Services ran into when he added plumbing to his septic company. He brought on one plumber, and sometimes that one doesn't work out, so now you're back to none. His lesson: one is none, two is some. Jason Birdsong of JT Services told me he's made this mistake several times. He had a really good person, a top revenue producer, so he promoted them. He didn't give them the skill set to lead people.
